env: A Harbor-hosted DGX Spark environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and NGC access to `nvcr.io/nvstaging/vss-core/vss-rt-cv` plus `nvstaging/vss-warehouse/vss-warehouse-app-data`. The VSS repository is checked out at `{{repo_root}}`, and the build skill writes to a fresh self-contained build directory under `{{repo_root}}/_builds/rt-cv-person-detection-rtdetr-harbor/` (or the next suffixed collision-resolved folder). This is a generation-focused eval for edge hardware: the generated output must stay self-contained under `_builds/`, must not modify upstream compose files under `deploy/docker/`, and must account for DGX-SPARK SBSA image-tag requirements when preparing the RT-CV detection/tracking deployment with the same warehouse video sets.

expects.query: Use the `/vss-build-vision-agent` skill to generate an RT-CV detection/tracking deployment on Harbor for `{{platform}}` from `{{repo_root}}`. Submit this exact prompt to the skill: "Create a profile for generating bounding box cv metadata (object detection and tracking) of persons using RT-DETR. Use the same warehouse video sets and expose the RT-CV API for health and metrics." Choose a new build under `_builds/`, keep the generated output self-contained, and target the Harbor / DGX-SPARK environment.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/` contains a new Harbor-targeted RT-CV detection/tracking build folder with `compose.yml`, `.env.template`, `MANIFEST.md`, and `allow-list.yml`.
The generated architecture and allow-list resolve to the required components: VIOS + RT-CV + ELK + Kafka.
The generated allow-list includes the RT-CV services contributed by `integrate-vss-detection-tracking-2d.md`, including `perception-2d-fusion`.
The generated output references patched copies under `_builds/<name>/patched/`, not upstream compose files directly.
No upstream compose file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified by generation.

The generated manifest or env output explicitly handles DGX-SPARK SBSA image requirements for the Harbor target. At minimum it must either (a) preselect SBSA tags such as `PERCEPTION_TAG=*sbsa*` for RT-CV and the corresponding SBSA-capable VIOS / nvstreamer image tags, OR (b) document the DGX-SPARK-specific SBSA tag swap the operator must apply before deploy.
The architecture proposal or manifest describes RT-DETR detection / tracking metadata flowing to Kafka and Elasticsearch while using the warehouse sample video set.
